title: Chapter 549
text:
Hu!

Godora's spaceship landed, and Nagojin walked over to Han Xiao.

"How's the situation? Have you dealt with the Mutation Source?"

Nagojin asked anxiously.

"It's done." Han Xiao casually replied and retracted his Mechanical Force. Starting from his limbs, the mechanical suit on his body folded layer by layer and returned to the compressed orb necklace.

"Command change, hum … begin recall of Mechanical Beast Guards …"

The next moment, the thousands of mechanical objects folded at the same time and turned back into compressed orbs. Pulled by the electromagnetic chain, they automatically rolled to the side of Han Xiao.

Han Xiao took out a compressed orb from his hand and turned it into a long black and red metal box about two meters tall. The compressed orbs rolled in one after another and filled up the box. Following which, the box automatically closed, and a line of '001' could be seen on the box.

This box was a 'mobile army camp', a necessary tool for the Army Style. Different Mech Legion numbers were stored in individual army boxes, and each army box represented an army.

The Mechanical Beast Guards Army was numbered 001, and this was the first army that Han Xiao had completed. The army box contained compressed orbs of a mechanical formation, and the door of the box was controlled by a strong magnetic key. It was difficult to open using other methods, and only Han Xiao could control it.

When the box was filled with other compressed orbs, the army box itself would not be able to transform into a compressed orb. While it was not portable enough, it was not troublesome to use. With Philip's control and the high speed module of the army box, there was no need to carry the army box around all the time. As long as he gave the order, the army box would be able to reach the battlefield quickly.

The bottom of the army box shot out flames, and it quickly rose into the air before entering the cabin of the BlackLight Stealth. There was a simple cleaning and maintenance workshop in the cabin to check the damage of the machines. Their opponents were beasts that were much weaker than them, so their losses were minimal.

At this moment, the beast horde had fled, and the battle had already ended. Nagojin quickly organized his men to clean up the battlefield. He took out his detector and realized that the reaction of the Mutation Source had completely disappeared.

"That's great! I'll inform the higher-ups right away. The research department's antidote is a success!" Nagojin was overjoyed.

At this time, the mercenary group's spaceship also arrived at the scene, and Herlous appeared with his men. Han Xiao ordered the mercenaries to clean up the battlefield and move the corpses of the beasts back. These were all raw materials. Yi Yeqing could make gene potions. Although they were not of much use to him, selling them to the players was still a bonus.

Jupiter and the others didn't manage to get any kills and even died a couple of times. They stood in the distance, frustrated.

However, on the forums, the hundreds of thousands of players were very excited.

Just when Black Star had killed the Mutation Source, the progress of the [Mutation Disaster] Main Storyline Mission had suddenly increased explosively, making up for the remaining progress. A notification popped up on the interface: 'You have successfully protected the Blue Star', and the mission was completed!

All the Blue Star players received generous rewards from the Main Storyline Mission. Depending on the individual's progress, the rewards varied, but on average, the rewards far exceeded the rewards from the Side Missions.

However, the reason why the players were so excited was not because of the mission rewards but because the Blue Star Main Storyline Mission had finally been completed. This also meant that the next step was to enter the galaxy!

The players had been in the Blue Star for so long, and the galaxy was the main attraction for them. In the past, they could only watch Pork Bun's videos to understand the galaxy, but they would be able to experience it for themselves soon. The [Mutation Disaster] had just ended, and many players were already looking forward to the future development. They could not help but feel excited.

The reaction of the people of Blue Star was a completely different scene.

Ten minutes after the battle ended, the Sanctuary and the Six Nations received news from the people of Godora that the Mutation Source had been destroyed. Without hesitation, they immediately broadcasted this piece of good news, and all the refugees in front of their televisions or radios saw it.

In the cities of the Six Nations and the Black Phantom Sanctuary, countless people revealed looks of disbelief. Their faces gradually became agitated, and they cried tears of joy.

They had finally survived the calamity!

They were still alive!

In an instant, the entire world was cheering!

Cities after cities were enveloped in the joy of surviving the calamity. Some people were venting their emotions, some were dancing with joy, some were crying, and some were praying with gratitude.

The voices of countless people condensed into a surging sound wave that soared into the sky, echoing in the air.

The light of dawn had finally illuminated the future. Thinking back to the calamity that this planet had gone through, it was simply like hell. Now … everything was over.

The people of Blue Star had hope for the future once again.

The upper echelons of the Six Nations had a tacit understanding with Bennett. While announcing this piece of good news, they also announced that Black Star was the one who had killed the Mutation Source, creating a huge hype for him and making him into a savior of the world.

This was the moment when the people of Blue Star were overjoyed, and the effect of such propaganda was obvious. Almost all the refugees were filled with gratitude toward Black Star.

After the calamity ended, the Six Nations had no choice but to think about the future. They still maintained their respect for Godora, but in private, they had already accepted Black Star's words and placed their bets on Han Xiao.

Destroy the Mutation Source

Mission Completed!

Mission Rating: Perfect

Only by killing the Mutation Source would one be able to obtain a [Perfect] rating.

Planet Legendary Point (Blue Star): The Mutation Terminator. The calamity brought about by the Mutation Source swept through the entire Blue Star. Order collapsed, and countless people lost their lives.

Han Xiao's current mission reward quota was already very high. The percentage increase brought about by one Planet Legend Point was very obvious.

After looking at the basic rewards, Han Xiao's focus was on the first kill reward for obtaining the two abilities of the Mutation Source. To him, this was the most valuable reward.

Han Xiao did not act immediately. He looked around and found Fu Ding. Without saying anything, he touched him to his heart's content.

"It's steady, it's steady. I feel like this wave of destiny is protecting me."

Han Xiaoxin rubbed his hands in satisfaction. Under Fu Ding's helpless gaze, he ran to the side and began to draw.

Note: The Mutation Source is a special life form and is unable to extract its innate abilities. Some of the abilities that can be extracted have been adjusted automatically.

Sure enough, the skill effects have been adjusted. Han Xiao nodded to himself.

This was a common situation when drawing Ability Type Rewards. If the target race was too special, some abilities could not be replicated. For example, the Mutation Source could change its physical form, share its senses, and control its emotions. These were all special talents.

For example, if a human player were to draw the ability of a Demon, a special talent like True Name Liberation would naturally not be able to be extracted. To be more specific, the Demons had abilities like 'Tail Strike', but human players did not have a fourth leg. Thus, they would naturally not be able to extract such abilities.

Against a target with a huge difference in species, even if it was an ability that could be extracted, there would be a change in its effect. It would be stripped of the latent influence of the target race and become a more adaptable ability.

Randomizing … Randomizing complete.

Please choose two of the five options below as the reward:

1. [Harden] – Ability: + 65% Physical Resistance, -30% DEX, Energy Consumption: 50. Duration: 14 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

2. [Intermediate Cell Proliferation Control] – Talent: Uses energy to proliferate cells and heal wounds. Energy Consumption is converted into HP at a ratio of 1: 5. Maximum recovery rate: 28% HP/s.

3. [Grind] – Ability: Close combat ability. When using entanglement, grappling, or locking skills, it can deal damage eight times. Each time, it will deal 40% – 60% damage. Depending on the location of the attack, there is a chance of inflicting [Fracture], [Paralysis], and other statuses. Energy Consumption: 60 and Stamina: 140. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

4. [Energy Storage] – Ability: Obtain an additional energy slot, which is 25% of your maximum energy. When expending the additional energy slot, it will not affect your own energy bonus. After activating this ability, the effect will last for two days. Cooldown: 3 days. (The value of the additional energy slot will not be counted into the energy bonus.)

5. [Intermediate Energy Absorption] – Talent: When receiving physical, magical, or energy attacks, 60% of the damage that is reduced by your resistance will be converted into energy.

After the adjustments, the effects of abilities and talents could be strengthened or weakened. The Cell Proliferation and Energy Absorption Talents had been stripped of the special effects of the Mutation Source, and their effects had been reduced.

However, the appearance of these two talents at the same time gave Han Xiao a huge surprise.

In his eyes, these two talents were the most valuable abilities of the Mutation Source. While the effects of just one of them were not bad, it was still mediocre. However, having both at the same time would result in a chemical reaction!

Simply put, he would be able to recover his energy if he was hit, and he would be able to recover his HP if he used his energy. While the recovery rate was not as perverse as the Mutation Source, his HP was still high. With close to 38,000 HP, even if he could only recover 28% of his HP every second, it would still be extremely impressive. The actual recovery rate was almost twice that of the Mutation Source!

While the other three abilities were not bad, they were not competitive at all.

Even if the effects of these two talents were slightly weaker, it was only slightly weaker compared to the original version. Individually, they were not considered weak at all, and they still reached the standard of a Molding Talent. Han Xiao could not be more satisfied.

At the start, he felt that he would have profited if he were to get just one of them, and he was mentally prepared to not be able to get either of them. Who would have thought that he would be so lucky this time? Was touching Fu Ding really that effective?

Han Xiao could not help but look at Fu Ding with a fiery gaze. He could not help but want to extract a few hundred Ability Potions from him right now. Fu Ding and Chen Xing, who were in his body, both shivered.

The Goddess of Luck loved to stretch out her leg and kick people. When it came to Fu Ding, she would stretch out her leg so that he could touch it. What else was there to say? They were different!

You have received [Intermediate Cell Proliferation Control] Talent!
